item.title: Week 10: Patriots at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 9:30 AM ET | Line: DET -2.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 57% | On paper this is close: New England's best edge is its passing game (7th in EPA per dropback, +0.18), and Detroit's counter is its pass rush (3rd in pressure rate, 23% generated) against a New England line ranked 24th at 23%. Maye ranks 9th of 31 in EPA per dropback to Goff's 11th, and Amon-Ra St. Brown draws 33% of Detroit's targets, with a WOPR of 0.75 ranked 6th of 108, against a New England pass defense ranked 21st. The model favors Detroit at 54%, led by a rushing matchup worth 1.2 points and offensive injuries worth 0.3 points, both toward Detroit.
